verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a first-party JavaScript package you add to your bundle and initialize in code (`initForeloopFeedback` with an API key and reporter details), which is an official SDK-style integration, but only for embedding the feedback widget. The CLI (with stable `--json` output) and the MCP endpoint are separate interfaces, not SDKs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose SDK covering projects, intentions and tasks; documented SDK languages beyond JavaScript; an SDK API reference and versioning policy; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: A package in your bundle, for teams building a full app. Costs you a build step and buys flexibility: pass the signed-in user, re-initialize when they change, and serve the asset yourself.
